note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the soldier is not described in the original; worker head length and fontanelle diameter are omitted owing to OCR damage, as is the number of cubital branches of the forewing; synonymic lists, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and postclypeus pale yellowish brown; antennae, labrum, legs and body paler than the head; abdominal tergites and sternites hyaline. Head and body rather densely pilose. Head capsule subcircular, maximum width 1.0 mm. Fontanelle punctiform. Antennae 14-segmented; 3rd segment subequal in length to the 2nd and subdivided. Postclypeus 0.23 mm long and 0.47 mm wide, with a few long setae. Labrum broadly lingulate, 0.37 mm long and 0.43 mm wide. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum as in the soldier, 0.30 mm long and 0.57 mm wide. Legs as in the genus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark reddish brown; postclypeus, legs and pronotum yellowish brown; antennae and labrum pale yellowish brown; abdominal tergites reddish brown, paler than the head; sternites yellowish brown, paler medially. Head and body covered by a thick layer of short setae and some long setae. Head capsule subcircular (0.93 mm to the mandibular base, 1.30 mm wide including the eyes). Fontanelle large, oval, ocellus-like (maximum diameter 0.15 mm, minimum diameter 0.10 mm), situated in the mid-dorsal part of the vertex. Compound eyes circular, maximum diameter 0.30 mm. Ocelli broadly oval, semitransparent (maximum diameter 0.13 mm, minimum diameter 0.11 mm); separated from the compound eye by 0.09 mm, slightly less than their short diameter. Antennae 14–15-segmented, 3rd segment shortest. Postclypeus inflated, pilose; length (0.27 mm) less than half its width (0.60 mm). Anteclypeus glabrous, flat, projecting forwards medially. Labrum lingulate, apex truncate (0.40 mm long, 0.47 mm wide). Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head width including the eyes (0.67 mm long, maximum width 1.17 mm); anterior margin slightly incurved, without notch; posterior margin nearly straight, without notch. Legs as in the genus. Wings pale brown; venation as in the genus; media of the forewing with 3 main branches; media of the hindwing unbranched or forked in the apical quarter, cubitus with 9 main branches. Forewing length excluding the scale 11.3 mm, hindwing length excluding the scale 10.0 mm.
